data.name: Panache
data.description: More than just a lightly armored warrior, a swashbuckler is a daring combatant. She fights with panache: a fluctuating measure of a swashbuckler's ability to perform amazing actions in combat. At the start of each day, a swashbuckler gains a number of panache points equal to her Charisma modifier [%1] (minimum 1). Her panache goes up or down throughout the day, but usually cannot go higher than her Charisma modifier [%1] (minimum 1), though feats and magic items can affect this maximum. A swashbuckler spends panache to accomplish deeds (see below), and regains panache in the following ways. [Max Points = %2]|PanachePoints|Panache_Cap
